h1: Flutter integrations for payments, analytics and your backend
overview: We connect your Flutter app to the services your business runs on: store purchases, analytics, push and email providers and your own API. You get working flows and plain notes on how each service is configured.

faq: Which packages do you use for purchases?
Usually the official in_app_purchase plugin or RevenueCat, depending on your needs. Digital content must use each store's billing, and we follow those rules. Stripe suits physical goods and services.
Do you write native code if a plugin is missing?
Yes, small Kotlin and Swift pieces behind a platform channel when no good plugin exists. We test it on both systems and document it so your team can maintain it.
You do. Accounts, fees and keys are yours, and each provider bills you directly. We set up the connections inside your accounts and never ask for your passwords.
We connect to a backend you already have, or to a hosted service such as Firebase or Supabase. Designing and building a large backend is a separate project we can quote.
